Wsla problems:

Spawing objects on OnNetworkSpawn
recycling netpackets

who's gonna spawn distributable items?
who ever spawns them has got to assign owners
make them only applicable to scene items?
---------------------------------------------

Possible objects authority:
1. transferable scene item - spawned with scene
2. requestable scene item - spawned with scene
3. authoritative scene item - spawned with scene

1. explicit prefab - spawned by local client
2. transferable prefab - spawned by local client
3. requestable prefab - spawned by local client
4. authoritative prefab - spawned by master

scene objects are never explicit
authoritative objects are always controlled by the master client

transferable scene objects will get assigned a random owner
transferable prefabs will get assigned their sender as the owner
transferable prefabs will transfer to a different client when their owner disconnects & they have an appropriate lifetime
authority can never be changed once set
----------------------------------------------------------------

Possible objects lifetimes:
scene objects always have a scene lifetime
prefabs have (client, scene, persistent) lifetimes
explicit prefabs will always despawn when their owner disconnects
lifetime can never be changed once set
